source_contracts: src/main.rs cmd_reopen emits only the target ID and invokes revision-guarded native reopen.
src/cli.rs --no-auto-flush is global; main's publication probe returns early for this flag.
src/service/lifecycle.rs reopen changes status, clears close metadata/manual-blocked/assignment, advances one revision and appends reopened history.
src/cli_history.rs projects commit-ordered events with stable anchored revisions and specific reopened/updated field names.
src/service/manifest.rs changes descriptions through before/after objects; both report sides may use the known redaction marker.

conclusions: All exact plan, review, template, protocol, old mapping, native binary and current workspace inputs are bound before writes.
The current full inventory is authoritative for unrelated task states and revisions, preserving newly completed backend tasks.
Exactly four reviewed closed revision-2 tasks are reopened with current guards; no restore, create, graph edit, direct SQL mutation or invented claim is present.
Every mutation has a durable intent, raw stdout/stderr and exit record; complete row/edge and history comparisons precede the next operation.
The twelve description operations are constructed only from the exact accepted template and current post-reopen revisions, with unchanged dry-run readback.
Both whole JavaScript bodies parsed without execution after removing import declarations; root still performs ordinary Node parsing.
Literal descriptions remain mandatory in actual full readback even when report projection text is redacted.
All 954 original CLI records, unrequested stored continuation fields, config and selected pointer are checked unchanged.
Native history preserves original close events and appends exactly reopened plus description updated records.
All raw inventories are written once; the helper uses 180-second total and 30-second native-call bounds, with root-owned 512 MiB Job and 128 MiB Node heap required.
Existing outputs cause refusal, uncertain mutation cannot be automatically replayed, and final plan result is created only after all checks.
The closer mechanically reverses byte-for-byte to the tested v5 source after only its four revision-6 binding substitutions.
